offers_products.reason: Sells oilfield specialty chemicals (Complex Nano-Fluid, friction reducers, surfactants, polymers) and ProFrac-related data analytics equipment.

offers_services.reason: Offers data analytics services (Data as a Service), reservoir analysis and fluid design support, though smaller than chemical sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are oil and gas operators and service companies, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells chemistry to oil and gas operators, pressure pumping service companies and multinational corporations.

recurring_revenue.reason: Chemicals are consumables reordered for ongoing well completions; customers repeat purchase, though tied to drilling activity.

cyclical_demand.reason: Oil and gas operators cut drilling and completion spending when prices fall, reducing demand for stimulation chemicals.

big_ticket.reason: Chemical blends are consumables bought frequently in repeat orders for each well, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufactured chemicals and data technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large oil and gas operators, pressure pumping companies and multinationals.

asset_heavy.reason: Chemical blending and distribution need moderate plants; not heavy fleets or networks. Leans asset-light relative to oilfield services.

notes: Reasons for products and asset intensity rest partly on general knowledge. Chemistry is the larger business; data analytics is smaller.
